p.src: 1  Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

ja: いなさい。あなたがたにも
en: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
u.src: 1  Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

p.src: 2  Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

ja: りに専念し、感謝をもって
en: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
u.src: 2  Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

p.src: 3  praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

ja: らせてくださるよう祈ってください。

en: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
u.src: 4  that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

en: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
u.src: 5  Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

ja: つけされたものにしなさい。そうすれば、

en: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

ja: ばれるイエスも、よろしくと

ja: であり、キリストのしもべであるエパフラスが、よろしくと
であなたがたのために力を尽くしています。それは、あなたがたが
